evidence.quote: In the admission letter, visa applicants will find all the instructions to register at the Universitaly portal and go forward with the visa procedure.
For the academic year 2026/2027, the application deadline on Universitaly is 15 September 2026.

notes: Tuition left out: the pages supply no amount in EUR for a non-EU student living abroad for this programme; the only money mentioned is a non-refundable application fee (€40.00 for 2027/2028 and €30.00 for 2026/2027), which is not tuition. Documents left out: no document list is given for this specific Bachelor; the lists on the application pages are for Bachelor's/Single-Cycle/Master's degree programmes in general. Duration left out: the pages never state the number of years of the Heritage Innovation Engineering programme. Intake deadlines left out: no deadline is attributed specifically to this programme, and the general call deadlines are not shown as applying to Heritage Innovation Engineering.

note.fr: Vérifiez les critères d'entrée par pays (UniME Entry Criteria by Country) pour confirmer que votre Baccalauréat marocain permet l'accès à ce Bachelor.
note.en: Check the UniME Entry Criteria by Country to confirm that your Moroccan Baccalauréat qualifies for entry to this Bachelor.
